descriptionChirho: The proper name Kohath (קְהָת), second son of Levi and ancestor of the Kohathite clan responsible for transporting sacred furnishings (Gen 46:11; Ex 6:16,18; Nu 3:17,19,27,29-30; 4:2,4,15,34-37; 7:9; 10:21; 26:57-58; Josh 21:5,10,20,26; 1Chr 6:1-2,16,18,22,38,46,54,61,66,70; 15:5; 23:6,12; 2Chr 29:12; 34:12). All clusters are the same person with different grammatical particles: bare name, with conjunction waw, and with preposition lamed. Spanish 'Coat/Quehat,' Arabic 'قَهَاتَ,' Korean '고핫,' Swahili 'Kohathi,' and Hindi 'कहात' are uniform throughout.
